svg.text: A100 · TriangleAttention (starting node) · training · fused path: d_pair 64 / 128, 2 or 4 heads of 16 / 32, bf16, broadcast dropout, L = 128k
forward (saves xh1, mean / rstd, qkvg, bias, o, lse, ds)
xh, (mean, rstd) = LN statistics in registers
qkvg = xh @ W'.T + b; bias = ... masked
lse = logsumexp(s) # base 2, per (h, i, j)
F3 · gate + out proj + dropout + residual
HBM (sizes at L = 768, d_pair 64, 4 heads x 16)
backward; D = [dq | dk | dv | dg], one buffer, each slice written by its producer
W_t = W_*ᵀ (the dgrad operands), W_oᵀ, γ in fp32
dy = dout · ds; da = dy @ W_o
do = da · sigmoid(g); dg = da · o · s · (1 - s)
a = sigmoid(g) · o; Δ = Σ_d o · do # per head
bias_t[h, k, j] = bias[h, j, k]
P^T = exp2(scale · k q^T + bias_t - lse); dS^T = P^T (v do^T - Δ)
dv = P^T do; dk = sm_scale · dS^T q
# per pair row i, head h, 128-key tile
P = exp2(scale · q k^T + bias - lse); dS = P (do v^T - Δ)
db[h, j, k] = Σ_i dS_i # R = 4 rows per CTA, then a fixed-order reduce
B5 · projection dgrad + LN backward + residual
dx = rstd (dxn γ - mean(dxn γ) - xh mean(dxn γ xh))
G = Dᵀ @ xh1; G_b = dbᵀ @ xh1 # K = L²
dW = G γ + G[:, D] βᵀ; dγ = Σ_o W ⊙ G; dβ = Σ_o W s
HBM (sizes at L = 768, d_pair 64, 4 heads x 16)
